---
title: "swissSURFACE3D to DEM / DSM"
description: "Discover point-cloud tiles and derive elevation rasters."
---

<div class="toolbox-kind">Recipe · implementation pending</div>

## Intended workflow

```text
polygon or bbox
  → discover intersecting STAC tiles
  → inspect and download LAZ/LAS assets
  → combine point clouds
  → select ground / surface returns
  → derive DEM and DSM
  → export GeoTIFF
```

Clipping exactly to the input polygon is optional; retaining the complete area covered by selected tiles is a valid mode.

PDAL is the leading implementation candidate because this is primarily point-cloud filtering and rasterization, not dataframe work. Before adding commands, test current STAC assets, point classifications, CRS metadata, raster resolution, nodata handling and PDAL writer settings on real tiles.
